title: NudgeRatchet has no rescueERC20; out-of-band USDC is permanently stranded
description: NudgeRatchet._dispatch forwards only the explicitly-passed `amount`. Any USDC that reaches the contract out-of-band — a direct transfer, dust, or an over-send beyond the dispatched amount — is permanently stranded: NudgeRatchet exposes no owner recovery / rescueERC20 function. This is an asymmetry against the sibling dispatcher BalancerPoolerV2, which provides rescueERC20 (BalancerPoolerV2.sol:350). Impact is bounded (only out-of-band funds, no in-protocol accounting is affected) so this is QA-bundled Low, not Medium.
impact: Bounded fund-stranding: USDC sent to NudgeRatchet outside the normal dispatch flow cannot be recovered by the owner. No effect on dispatched amounts or in-protocol accounting; loss is limited to mistakenly/dust-transferred tokens.
attackPath: USDC arrives at NudgeRatchet out-of-band (direct transfer, dust, or over-send beyond dispatched amount).
_dispatch only ever forwards the explicitly-passed amount; the surplus is never swept.
No rescueERC20 / owner recovery exists on NudgeRatchet (unlike BalancerPoolerV2.sol:350).
The out-of-band USDC is permanently stranded.
recommendation: Add an owner-only rescueERC20 (mirroring BalancerPoolerV2.sol:350) so out-of-band tokens can be recovered, or document that NudgeRatchet must never receive out-of-band transfers.
